title: What Happens When Your Stomach Growls?
sources: Cleveland Clinic Health Essentials, 'Hunger Pangs' (stomach rumbling is the noise produced by the movement of gas and fluids in your digestive system; it's caused by the contraction of the muscles in your stomach and intestines; stomach rumbling can occur at any time, such as swallowing air, drinking carbonated beverages or having an empty stomach; hunger pangs are caused by contractions in the muscles of your stomach and intestines due to the release of the hormone ghrelin, the hunger hormone, when your stomach is empty; 'In most cases, hunger can set in as soon as two hours after your last meal'; if the noise is coming from the lower part of the abdomen, it may be the food is now passing through the small and large intestines): https://health.clevelandclinic.org/hunger-pangs

NIH MedlinePlus, 'Abdominal sounds' (abdominal sounds are the noises made by the intestines; most of the sounds you hear in your stomach and intestines are due to normal digestion; most bowel sounds are normal and simply mean that the gastrointestinal tract is working): https://medlineplus.gov/ency/article/003137.htm
Tease (next video): Cleveland Clinic, 'Nosebleed (Epistaxis)' ('The most common cause of nosebleeds is dry air'): https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/diseases/13464-nosebleed-epistaxis

lines.text: What happens when your stomach growls?
Hunger can kick in just two hours after you eat, but the growl isn't always hunger.
lines.caps: *HUNGER CAN KICK | IN JUST 2 *HOURS | AFTER YOU *EAT | BUT THE *GROWL | ISN'T ALWAYS *HUNGER

lines.text: That sound is gas and fluid on the move,
lines.caps: THAT *SOUND IS | *GAS AND FLUID | ON THE *MOVE

lines.text: pushed by the muscles of your stomach and intestines.
lines.caps: *PUSHED BY THE | *MUSCLES OF YOUR | STOMACH AND *INTESTINES

lines.text: An empty stomach sets off a hunger hormone,
and those squeezes become hunger pangs.
But it can rumble at any time.
Swallowed air or fizzy drinks do it too.
A rumble down low? Maybe just food passing through your intestines.
lines.caps: A *RUMBLE DOWN LOW? | MAYBE JUST *FOOD | PASSING THROUGH YOUR *INTESTINES

lines.text: Most of the time, it just means your gut's working.
lines.caps: MOST OF THE *TIME | IT JUST *MEANS | YOUR GUT'S *WORKING
